title: Nanoprecipitation in Ni-Cr alloys Formed Under Heavy-Ion Irradiation and its Impact on Molten Salt Corrosion
content: Structural materials in nuclear reactors degrade under a variety of extremes such as irradiation, high temperatures, and corrosion [1,2]. Drawing the connection between the microstructure formed by ion bombardment and its response to corrosion is imperative to understanding material performance at desired operating conditions. These predictions, however, are a challenge based on varied interactions among alloying elements, salt species, and nanoscale features that are present under non-equilibrium ion bombardment [3,4].
